about_short_description.short_description: Pilot is a platform that offers bookkeeping, tax, and CFO services for growing businesses.

product.name: Bookkeeping Services
product.description: Monthly bookkeeping for startups and small businesses, including transaction categorization, monthly closes, accrual accounting, and financial reporting.

product.name: CFO Services
product.description: Strategic finance support covering budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, fundraising preparation, investor materials, and growth planning.

product.name: Tax Services
product.description: Business tax preparation and filing, including federal, state, local, and 1099 filings, coordinated with bookkeeping.

product.name: AI Accountant
product.description: An AI-enabled accounting assistant that answers questions about business finances and provides access to financial information through the Pilot platform.

product.name: Outsourced Operations
product.description: Back-office operational support such as bill payment, invoicing, payroll coordination, and other recurring finance-related administrative work.

product.name: R&D Credit
product.description: A managed research and development tax-credit service that handles the process of identifying, documenting, and claiming eligible credits.
